summary: Verified admin-to-admin messaging notification fix. All 9 backend API tests pass. The fix correctly implements per-admin unread count tracking using read_by_admins array on admin messages. When Admin A sends a message, Admin B's unread count increases. When Admin B opens the conversation, their unread count decreases. Sender's own messages don't count as unread for them.

test_results.frontend: N/A - No frontend changes to test

seed_data_creation: None - used existing admin accounts and conversations
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin-to-admin messaging notification fix verified. Key verifications: 1) /api/conversations/admin/unread-count returns per-admin unread counts, 2) When Admin A sends message, Admin B's unread count increases by 1, 3) When Admin B opens conversation, their unread count decreases, 4) Admin messages include read_by_admins array with sender's ID, 5) Sender's own messages don't count as unread for them. Push notifications to other admins are triggered via send_other_admins_notification function (no active device tokens in preview environment to verify actual push delivery).

admin_message_read_by_admins.details: Admin messages include read_by_admins array with sender's ID

admin_message_increases_other_unread.details: When Admin A sends message, Admin B's unread count increases by 1

opening_conversation_marks_read.details: When admin opens conversation, messages from other admins are marked as read

conversation_list_unread_count.details: Conversation list includes per-admin unread_count for each conversation

note_on_push_notifications: The send_other_admins_notification function is called correctly when an admin sends a message. However, actual push notification delivery cannot be verified in the preview environment as there are no active device tokens registered. The function logs '[PUSH] No active admin devices found' when no tokens exist.
